reason: The patch correctly addresses the limitation of the original code, which only handled characters within the Basic Multilingual Plane (BMP). By using Character.toChars(entityValue) for values exceeding 0xFFFF, the unescaper now correctly supports supplementary characters (Unicode codepoints above U+FFFF) by converting them into the appropriate surrogate pairs for the Writer.
